notes:
New Features:

+ Adds 240p support for low-resolution HLS channels detected during safe manifest-only checks.

Bugfixes:

- Uses one canonical channel name for storing and displaying resolutions, fixing missing labels on names ending in Online and Penthouse TV/Penthouse Gold aliases.

- Migrates previously saved resolution records automatically and refreshes an existing Adult TV Test playlist without requiring a full recheck.

- Captures resolution directly from already validated CLICK master manifests when a channel is checked without normal Kodi playback.
